spawn_spec.prompt:
TASK: Implement Ferryx worktree-isolated tab/session state and restart persistence to turn the existing RED frontend tests green. This is an executable assignment.
DELIVERABLE: Production changes only in ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts, ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.ts, ui/src/lib/types.ts, and ui/src/App.tsx (do not rewrite the tests except to correct an objectively invalid assertion); a report of exact modified behavior and GREEN outputs.
SCOPE: Preserve unrelated uncommitted edits exactly. Implement the selected model: (1) state.layout is the active worktree's complete layout; inactive worktree layouts are stored by path and atomically swapped on worktree selection; sessions remain project-global; (2) new terminal/browser tabs are added to the path captured at initiation, even if selection changes while async creation resolves; BrowserTab retains its worktreePath; (3) serialize all worktree layouts and only sessions they reference; deserialize old flat payloads compatibly and v3 per-worktree payloads without losing pane trees, tab groups, browser metadata, or dead-session respawn data; (4) merge the active workspace update into an existing full PersistedWorkspaceSession instead of overwriting other workspace entries; load the current session before close/autosave merge, serialized saves must not race such that a stale workspace state gets written after selection. (5) App must treat restored parked layouts as a successful restore and preserve terminal respawn behavior for all restored worktree sessions.
VERIFY: From ui run exactly: bun test src/state/workspaceStore.test.tsx src/lib/sessionPersistence.test.ts src/App.test.tsx; then bun run build. Both must exit 0. Run an LSP diagnostic check for every production TypeScript file modified.
STOP WHEN: All RED frontend tests are GREEN, the UI build passes, diagnostics are clean, no test is weakened/deleted/skipped, and your report names the exact evidence. Do not commit.
